items.title: Arjun Jain, Kunal Jain, and Lokesh Kamanboina are Building Tandem to Bring the Efficiency of AI to Hardware Engineering
items.summary: Amidst the AI revolution, hardware engineering has remained largely unchanged, relying on disconnected tools, teams, and manual processes. Learn how Tandem is building an AI-native platform for hardware engineering, automating manual processes across the mechanical engineering development cycle.

items.title: Every is Sponsoring Founder Institute's FounderX To Help Founders Win in the Agentic Era
items.summary: FounderX is Founder Institute’s pinnacle gathering, designed to help founders learn how to win in the agentic era. Every is proud to be sponsoring FounderX, with Every CEO leading a featured workshop on founder branding.

items.title: Jennifer Claman is Building Gynovent to Design Women's Health Devices That Put Patients First
items.summary: Many women's health devices aren't designed with the patient's experience in mind. That's why Jennifer Claman is building Gynovent, a women’s health medical device company built to create innovative products that women truly want and physicians genuinely need.

items.title: How Tandem focused on raising $4.9 million, while Every took care of back-office worries
items.summary: Tandem's co-founders tried to figure out HR, payroll, compliance, and taxes themselves — until the 'unknowns' started piling up. Learn why they outsourced their entire back office to Every, and how that freed them up to build their AI-native solution for hardware engineers and raise $4.9 million.

items.title: How Every helped MLPal.ai avoid a $100K compliance gap
items.summary: First-time founder Sai Vivek Peddi partnered with Every from day one to navigate incorporation, banking, taxes, and US compliance as a foreign founder. Learn why he chose Every — and how a simple onboarding checklist helped MLPal.ai avoid up to $100K in potential government fines.

items.title: Inside Sai Vivek Peddi's Journey Building MLPal: Enabling Enterprises to Create Their Own Agentic Systems
items.summary: Enterprises across industries are racing to deploy agentic AI solutions. But most use cases never make it to production. Learn how Sai Vivek Peddi is building MLPal, a horizontal platform that enables enterprises to build agentic systems for the unique workflows of their business.

items.title: Teddy Yip and Joanna Chen are Building Narrative AI to Automate Manufacturing for Creator-Founders
items.summary: Modern creators understand their audiences better than anyone. But when they set out to launch a product line, manufacturing can be a nightmare. Learn how Teddy Yip and Joanna Chen are building Narrative AI to automate manufacturing workflows for creator-founders.

items.title: Announcing Every + Stable: The Operational Foundation for Modern Businesses
items.summary: Learn how Every and Stable are partnering to help high-growth businesses simplify and automate their operational foundation.

items.title: Early-Stage Startup Success: 10 Tips from Your Peers
items.summary: Discover 10 tips from 100+ early-stage founders. Learn what successful startup founders are doing, from co-founder selection to back-office management.
